name: Chat notifications
description: Posts a short message to a team chat channel when deals are won, new deals or leads arrive, or tickets come in. Works with any chat service that accepts incoming webhooks.

settings.label: Incoming webhook address
settings.help: The address your chat service gives you when you add an incoming webhook to a channel. It works like a password, so it is stored encrypted.

settings.label: What to post
settings.help: Which events send a message to the channel.

options.label: New leads, new and won deals, and new tickets

settings.label: Include record titles
settings.help: Add the deal or ticket title to each message. Leave off if the channel is shared outside your team. Names of people are never sent.
